en: Black‑and‑white view of a European riverside town with a large hilltop cathedral complex and adjacent castle-like buildings dominating the skyline. In the foreground a broad river flows from left to right; a long low cargo boat moves along the water. Two bridges span the river: an older arched stone bridge and, in front of it, a metal truss bridge on stone piers. On the right, a riverside embankment road with tram tracks curves alongside a rocky cliff with trees and houses above. People are walking and cycling along the promenade. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century cityscape. No text is visible on the image.
